Intro: Today, dear rival, I am not here for our feud. My fifty-fourth dish, Le Rat Bourguignon, is going well, but I cannot say the same for our friends.
There's an evil lurking in our streets, foreign from these lands. It's looking for something. Something with you.
You've seen it before, no? The pale one? No one cares more for your safety than I, your rival. I've been monitoring the situation here.
We must be vigilant, rival. That pale demon is looking for something. Take this rat of mine. If someone is in trouble, have Pockets come find me.
Success: Splendid as always, I cannot wait to settle our feud. Keep those who you care about safe. I shall endeavor the same! Us chefs must stick together.
Fail: Do not worry, rival. Us chefs will stick together. I just hope this dilemma will not impact our eventual feud. Keep those who you care about safe.
Reject: This is how you repay my kindness? What of our feud!?
